mechanism: Having read a note, the agent uses its value when it cannot see the register (it cannot tell a right note from a wrong one).
measures: Not drawn on its own any more, and still not measured on its own. The agent pilot (E5) measures the product p_read_note x p_adopt_blind, which is drawn from the pilot's interval; this parameter follows as the product divided by the assumed p_read_note. The range shown is the envelope of the values that can result.
estimable_note: Not identified on its own. The pilot fits a combination of parameters (the records named in the notes); this parameter follows from that combination and from an assumed parameter, so it stays an assumption.

value.distribution: not drawn on its own: it follows from a combination drawn from the pilot's interval and from an assumed parameter (gca_sim/quotation/params.py)

source.name: Declared assumption, constrained by the GCA controlled agent pilot (E5)

conditions: E4 quotation research model; every design, context and week
